entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-01
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Improper handling of `errSSLClosedGraceful` returned from `SSLWrite` on macOS #121272
  • SocketException (11001) Occurs Sporadically in HttpClient Requests Inside RunImpersonated Context #121269
  • JsonSerializer.Deserialize fails to deserialize to {ReadOnly}Memory<T> #121267
  • [API Proposal]: Interlocked.Max, Interlocked.Min #121264
  • Bounds check after overlapping span length checks #121262
  • Redundant bounds check #121259
    Future
  • createdump lacking exec bit on macOS PKG installers #121258
    10.0.x

Closed

  • Support for FreeBSD #14537
    Future
  • Arrays should not contribute to cyclic struct layout #12024
  • HttpUtility.JavaScriptStringEncode single quote behavior does not match documentation #100248
    Future
  • ILC writes object file even if errors were produced #121191

PullRequests

Created

  • [Bounds checks] Tighten pRange in MergeEdgeAssertions via X != CNS assertions #121273
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Clarify documentation workflows for assemblies with UseCompilerGeneratedDocXmlFile #121271
    area-Infrastructure-libraries
  • Remove more unsafe code from Uri internals #121270
    area-System.Net, reduce-unsafe, 11.0.0
  • Bugfix/113926 fix invalid jsonnode deserialization #121265
    area-System.Text.Json, community-contribution
  • Add URL scheme validation for HTTP redirects in SocketsHttpHandler #121263
    area-System.Net.Http, 11.0.0
  • Remove unsafe code from the Uri.UnescapeString helper #121261
    area-System.Net, reduce-unsafe, 11.0.0
  • [clr-interp] Handle tail-call return conversions, by requiring that the return type be equivalent in stack layout #121260
    needs-area-label

Merged

  • Capture PDBs in `--make-repro-path` #121163
    area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • Add -optimistic for crossgen2 option --instruction-set. #121203
    area-crossgen2-coreclr, community-contribution
  • ILC: Use temporary file to prevent invalid object files on compilation errors #121192
  • [clr-interp] Add various tweaks to allow code patterns around byref usage that are tested by various IL tests #121144
    needs-area-label

Updated

  • [RuntimeAsync] Enable runtime async in Libraries partition #119432
    NO-MERGE, area-VM-coreclr, linkable-framework, runtime-async
  • Support references to unmanaged function pointers in Reflection.Emit #121128
    area-System.Reflection.Emit, community-contribution
  • Optimize logic in SliceLongerSpanToMatchShorterLength #121104
    area-System.Memory, community-contribution
  • Add System.Text.RegularExpressions.Generator analyzers to .globalconfig #121149
    community-contribution, needs-area-label
  • Remove more unsafe code from IPAddress parsing #121225
    area-System.Net, reduce-unsafe, 11.0.0
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0' => 'release/9.0-staging' #120861
    Servicing-approved
  • Fix handling exceptions from native code when interpreted #121212
    area-CodeGen-Interpreter-coreclr, 11.0.0
  • Upgrade to ICU 72.1.0.4 #121202
    arch-wasm, area-System.Globalization, area-codeflow
  • [mono][sgen] Make color visible to client permanent #121247
    area-GC-mono
  • [release/10.0] [QUIC] Update Windows version of MsQuic #121198
    Servicing-approved, area-System.Net.Quic, 10.0.x
  • Add debug information for runtime async methods #120303
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, runtime-async
  • Consolidate NativeLibrary API to managed implementation #121058
    area-System.Runtime.InteropServices, community-contribution
  • Refactor NativeAOT helpers to align with CoreCLR patterns #121158
    needs-area-label
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 679: Build ID 2828948 #121062
    area-Infrastructure-libraries
  • Make sure we treat the ptrs as unsigned #121221
    area-System.Runtime.InteropServices.JavaScript
  • Replace conservative overflow check with int limit #121177
    area-VM-coreclr, community-contribution
